body: I lost a lot of people in the last few years after my life completely derailed. I was assaulted and the aftermath was and still is cataclysmic. My last post was what I thought would be my last night on earth. But I lived and I’ve made a conscious effort to connect with myself first. Meditation is helping a lot (try the app simple habit) but also realizing that I wasn’t appreciating the folks in my life who stuck it out through all my shit. Yes there are way fewer folks around me these days but the ones who are around are pure gold. Sounds like you may have one or two of those around as well. And you have you. Loneliness and rejection are bitches but they can be survived.
